MOTOR GRUPPEN AS is registered for trade, production, acquisition and operation of real estate and other economic activity, including participation in other companies. It was previously named MOTOR GRUPPEN (HOLDING) AS until 2003-06-19. Its main industry code is 47.810: retail sale of motor vehicles. The register's most recent update was on 2026-08-03 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
